UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated Firebase user profile with public display metadata and server-governed role assignment (zero PII).

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID.

role.description: Account role ('member' by default; 'admin' elevated by administrator).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated.

UserPrivateInfo.title: UserPrivateInfo
UserPrivateInfo.description: Private user account contact details isolated from the public profile document.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owning user.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the private record was updated.

AdminAllowlist.title: AdminAllowlist
AdminAllowlist.description: Read-only allowlist of Firebase Auth UIDs granted Firestore admin oversight.

grantedAt.description: Timestamp when admin status was provisioned.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores authenticated user display profiles and roles without exposing PII.

/users/{userId}/private/{docId}.description: Stores private account PII (verified email) accessible only to the owning user or an administrator.
